name: CE_CP_STMT_LINES_INT
description: This interface table contains the bank statement line.

columns.name: CP_STMT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Sequentially generated surrogate ket for the statement lines interface table.

columns.name: SOURCE_STMT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the statement header of the statement line.

columns.name: SOURCE_SYSTEM
columns.description: Name of source application of the statement line.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Source of bank statement line. Valid values are Prior-Day Bank Statement Line and Intra-day Bank Statement Line.

columns.name: SOURCE_STMT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the statement line.

columns.name: BOOKING_DATE
columns.description: Bank statement line booking date.

columns.name: VALUE_DATE
columns.description: Value date of the statement line.

columns.name: FLOW_INDICATOR
columns.description: Flow indicator of the transaction. Valid values are INFLOW or OUTFLOW.

columns.name: RECON_STATUS
columns.description: Reconciliation Status of the statement lines.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE

columns.name: BANK_ACCT_AMOUNT

columns.name: REPORTING_AMOUNT

columns.name: FUNCTIONAL_AMOUNT
